selected_records.title: On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons---a statistical look at the METR plot

article.body:
AI time-horizon paper provides no AV deployment evidence

An arXiv listing dated 8 October 2026 identifies a paper titled “On the estimation and validity of AI time horizons—a statistical look at the METR plot.” The supplied record contains no abstract or findings, and identifies no vehicle, autonomy stack, operating domain, safety data, deployment or regulatory approval. It therefore provides no evidence of an autonomous-vehicle test or service.
